Every project gets one page here and up to five docs, one of each kind in the key. The docs are plain Markdown in the [`wiki/`](https://github.com/shubhamcodess/shubhamcodess/tree/main/wiki) folder of the profile repo, so they're versioned, reviewed and diffed like code.

1. **Write** the doc as `wiki/<Project>-—-<Doc>.md`, starting from a template in [`wiki/.templates/`](https://github.com/shubhamcodess/shubhamcodess/tree/main/wiki/.templates).
2. **Build** with `python scripts/wiki.py`. It finds the new doc and marks it filed here, on the project page and in the sidebar.
3. **Push** to `main`. The [wiki workflow](https://github.com/shubhamcodess/shubhamcodess/actions/workflows/wiki.yml) rebuilds everything and publishes it to this wiki.
